services.desc: Let me mend and alter your favourite clothes so that they can work for you.
Get your crew together, I can demo basic fixes (and, of course, tailor your clothes).
Are you crafty yourself but want to skip the boring stuff? I can finish and block your knitted and crochet garments.
I sew, knit and crochet, let's make your next trunk show or sewing pattern look good.
